All work

Brand identity & website

T2 Design Solutions

T2 Design Solutions had evolved from a straightforward 3D visualisation studio, into leaders in creative technology with a global client base. They needed a brand that could harness their kaleidoscopic proposition.

The work

Challenge

T2 Design Solutions are transforming the way global giants like Sainbury's, Amazon, and Google use technology to visualise the future. Through prolific imagination and innovative application of technology, they have decoupled 3D visualising from the limitations of the real world. They needed a brand that inspired customers to reimagine the limits of their design processes.

Invention

Infinitely better design solutions . Our infinity mark is alive and constantly changing, and was produced by harnessing T2's 3D skills. It flows through the website, enveloping content and running through our words. A visual metaphor for effervescent imagination channelled through design technology. Our tone of voice is revealing, concise and serves as a jumping off point into world of unseen possibilities.

"The way you evolved our ideas into a finished product was nothing short of amazing. We’re thrilled to see our "Infinitely Better" concept also come to life and couldn't have done it without you." Tony Markham - Founder, T2DS.
